## History

Violetta is an imaginary friend invented by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during her childhood. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) pictured Violetta as a little girl who lived in an echo near Mrs. Hammond's house. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) loved Violetta almost as much as she loved [Katie Maurice](../character/katie-maurice.md), another of her imaginary companions.

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--violetta.md)

Violetta is an imaginary friend created by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), who envisioned her living within the echo of a valley. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) invents this companion to fulfill her desire for closeness and dialogue. Because Violetta exists solely in Anne's imagination, their relationship relies entirely on Anne's creative comfort and pretend interactions.

- presumed Friend of — imaginary friend imagined by Anne from an echo in a valley  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043)</sub>
